title: अंश ५ · अध्याय २७

items.text:
शम्बरेण ह्टतो वीरः प्रद्यु म्रः स कथं मुने !
शम्बरश्व महावीर्य्यः प्रद्यु म्नेन कथं हतः ।। ५-२७-१ ।।
items.tr:
śambareṇa hṭato vīraḥ pradyu mraḥ sa kathaṃ mune !
śambaraśva mahāvīryyaḥ pradyu mnena kathaṃ hataḥ || 5-27-1 ||

items.speaker: पराशर उवाच
items.text:
षष्ठेऽह्नि जातमात्रन्तु प्रद्युम्र सूतिकागृहात् ।
ममैष हन्तेति मुने! ह्टतवान् कालशम्बरः ।। ५-२७-२ ।।
items.tr:
ṣaṣṭhe'hni jātamātrantu pradyumra sūtikāgṛhāt |
mamaiṣa hanteti mune! hṭatavān kālaśambaraḥ || 5-27-2 ||

items.text:
ह्टत्वा चिक्षेप चैवैनं ग्राहोग्र लवणार्णावे ।
कल्लोलजनितावर्त्ते सुघोरे मकरालये ।। ५-२७-३ ।।
items.tr:
hṭatvā cikṣepa caivainaṃ grāhogra lavaṇārṇāve |
kallolajanitāvartte sughore makarālaye || 5-27-3 ||

items.text:
पतितं तत्र चैवैको मत्स्यो जग्राह बालकम् ।
न ममार च तस्यापि जठरेऽनलदीपितः ।। ५-२७-४ ।।
items.tr:
patitaṃ tatra caivaiko matsyo jagrāha bālakam |
na mamāra ca tasyāpi jaṭhare'naladīpitaḥ || 5-27-4 ||

items.text:
मतूस्यबन्धश्व मत्स्योऽसौ मत्स्यैरन्यैः सह द्रिज !
घातितोऽसुरवर्य्याय शम्बराय निवेदितः ।। ५-२७-५ ।।
items.tr:
matūsyabandhaśva matsyo'sau matsyairanyaiḥ saha drija !
ghātito'suravaryyāya śambarāya niveditaḥ || 5-27-5 ||

items.text:
तस्य मायावती नाम पत्री सर्व्वगृहेश्वरी ।
कारयामास सूदानामाधिपत्यमनिन्दिता ।। ५-२७-६ ।।
items.tr:
tasya māyāvatī nāma patrī sarvvagṛheśvarī |
kārayāmāsa sūdānāmādhipatyamaninditā || 5-27-6 ||

items.text:
दारिते मत्स्यजठरे सा ददर्शातिशोभनम् ।
कुमारं मन्मथतरोर्दग्धस्य प्रथमाङ्कुरम् ।। ५-२७-७ ।।
items.tr:
dārite matsyajaṭhare sā dadarśātiśobhanam |
kumāraṃ manmathatarordagdhasya prathamāṅkuram || 5-27-7 ||

items.text:
कोऽयं कथमयं मत्स्यजठरं समुपागतः ।
इत्येवं कौतुकाविष्टां तां तन्वीं प्राह नारादः ।। ५-२७-८ ।।
items.tr:
ko'yaṃ kathamayaṃ matsyajaṭharaṃ samupāgataḥ |
ityevaṃ kautukāviṣṭāṃ tāṃ tanvīṃ prāha nārādaḥ || 5-27-8 ||

items.text:
अयं समस्तजगतः सूतिसंहारकारिणा ।
शम्बरेण ह्टतः कृष्णृ-तनयः सूतिकागृहात् ।। ५-२७-९ ।।
items.tr:
ayaṃ samastajagataḥ sūtisaṃhārakāriṇā |
śambareṇa hṭataḥ kṛṣṇṛ-tanayaḥ sūtikāgṛhāt || 5-27-9 ||

items.text:
क्षिप्तः समुद्र मत्स्येन निगीर्णास्ते वशं गतः ।
नररत्रमिदं सुभ्रू विस्त्रब्धा परिपालय ।। ५-२७-१० ।।
items.tr:
kṣiptaḥ samudra matsyena nigīrṇāste vaśaṃ gataḥ |
nararatramidaṃ subhrū vistrabdhā paripālaya || 5-27-10 ||

items.text:
नारदेनैवमुक्ता सा पालयामास तं शिशुम् ।
बाल्यादेवातिरागेण रूपातिशयमोहिता ।। ५-२७-११ ।।
items.tr:
nāradenaivamuktā sā pālayāmāsa taṃ śiśum |
bālyādevātirāgeṇa rūpātiśayamohitā || 5-27-11 ||

items.text:
स यदा यौवनाभोग-भूषितोऽभून्महामते!
साभिलाषा तदा साति बभूव गजगामिनी ।। ५-२७-१२ ।।
items.tr:
sa yadā yauvanābhoga-bhūṣito'bhūnmahāmate!
sābhilāṣā tadā sāti babhūva gajagāminī || 5-27-12 ||

items.text:
मायावती ददौ तस्म मायाः सर्व्वा महामुन !
प्रद्यु म्रायातिरागान्धा तन्नयस्तह्टदयेक्षणा ।। ५-२७-१३ ।।
items.tr:
māyāvatī dadau tasma māyāḥ sarvvā mahāmuna !
pradyu mrāyātirāgāndhā tannayastahṭadayekṣaṇā || 5-27-13 ||

items.text:
प्रसज्जन्तीन्तु तामाह स कार्ष्णिः कमलेक्षणाम् ।
मातृभावमपाहाय किमेवं वर्त्तसेऽन्यथा ।। ५-२७-१४ ।।
items.tr:
prasajjantīntu tāmāha sa kārṣṇiḥ kamalekṣaṇām |
mātṛbhāvamapāhāya kimevaṃ varttase'nyathā || 5-27-14 ||

items.text:
सा चास्मै कथयामास न पुत्रस्त्वं ममेति वै ।
तनयं त्वामयं विष्णोह्ट तवान् कालशम्बरः ।। ५-२७-१५ ।।
items.tr:
sā cāsmai kathayāmāsa na putrastvaṃ mameti vai |
tanayaṃ tvāmayaṃ viṣṇohṭa tavān kālaśambaraḥ || 5-27-15 ||

items.text:
क्षिप्तः समुद्र मत्स्यस्य सम्प्राप्तो जठरान्मया ।
सा तु रोदिति ते माता कान्ताद्याप्यतिवत्सला ।। ५-२७-१६ ।।
items.tr:
kṣiptaḥ samudra matsyasya samprāpto jaṭharānmayā |
sā tu roditi te mātā kāntādyāpyativatsalā || 5-27-16 ||

items.text:
इत्युक्तः शम्बरं युद्धे प्रद्यु म्रः स समाह्वयत् ।
क्रोधाकुलीकृतमना युयुधे च महाबलः ।। ५-२७-१७ ।।
items.tr:
ityuktaḥ śambaraṃ yuddhe pradyu mraḥ sa samāhvayat |
krodhākulīkṛtamanā yuyudhe ca mahābalaḥ || 5-27-17 ||

items.text:
हत्वा सैन्यमशेषन्तु तस्य दैत्यस्य माधविः ।
सप्त माया व्यतिक्रम्य मायां प्रयुयुजेऽशष्टमीम् ।। ५-२७-१८ ।।
items.tr:
hatvā sainyamaśeṣantu tasya daityasya mādhaviḥ |
sapta māyā vyatikramya māyāṃ prayuyuje'śaṣṭamīm || 5-27-18 ||

items.text:
तया जघान तं दैत्यं मायया कालशम्बरम् ।
उत्पत्य च तया सार्द्धमाजगाम पितुर्गृहम् ।। ५-२७-१९ ।।
items.tr:
tayā jaghāna taṃ daityaṃ māyayā kālaśambaram |
utpatya ca tayā sārddhamājagāma piturgṛham || 5-27-19 ||

items.text:
अन्तः परे निपतितं मायावत्या समन्वितम् ।
तं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णसंकल्पा बभूवुः कृष्णयोषितः ।। ५-२७-२० ।।
items.tr:
antaḥ pare nipatitaṃ māyāvatyā samanvitam |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇasaṃkalpā babhūvuḥ kṛṣṇayoṣitaḥ || 5-27-20 ||

items.text:
रुक्मिणी चावदत् प्रेमूणा प्रम्णा साश्रुदृष्टिरनिन्दिता ।
धन्यायाः खल्वयं पुत्रो वर्त्तते नवयौवने ।। ५-२७-२१ ।।
items.tr:
rukmiṇī cāvadat premūṇā pramṇā sāśrudṛṣṭiraninditā |
dhanyāyāḥ khalvayaṃ putro varttate navayauvane || 5-27-21 ||

items.text:
अस्मिन् वयसि पुत्रो मे प्रद्यु म्रो यदि जीवति ।
सभाग्या जननी वतूस! त्वया कापि विभूषिता ।। ५-२७-२२ ।।
items.tr:
asmin vayasi putro me pradyu mro yadi jīvati |
sabhāgyā jananī vatūsa! tvayā kāpi vibhūṣitā || 5-27-22 ||

items.text:
अथवा यादृशः स्नेहो मम यादृगू वपुस्तव ।
हरेरपत्यं सुव्यक्त भवान् वत्स!भविष्यति ।। ५-२७-२३ ।।
items.tr:
athavā yādṛśaḥ sneho mama yādṛgū vapustava |
harerapatyaṃ suvyakta bhavān vatsa!bhaviṣyati || 5-27-23 ||

items.text:
एतिस्मिन्नन्तरे प्राप्तः सह कृष्णेन नारदः ।
अन्तः पुरचरीं देवीं रुक्मिणीं प्राह हर्षयन् ।। ५-२७-२४ ।।
items.tr:
etisminnantare prāptaḥ saha kṛṣṇena nāradaḥ |
antaḥ puracarīṃ devīṃ rukmiṇīṃ prāha harṣayan || 5-27-24 ||

items.text:
एश ते तनयः सुभ्रु! हत्वा शम्बरमागतः ।
ह्टतो येनाभवद् बालो भवत्याः सूतिकागृहात् ।। ५-२७-२५ ।।
items.tr:
eśa te tanayaḥ subhru! hatvā śambaramāgataḥ |
hṭato yenābhavad bālo bhavatyāḥ sūtikāgṛhāt || 5-27-25 ||

items.text:
इयं मायावती भार्य्या तनयस्यास्य ते सती ।
शम्बरस्य न भार्य्येयं श्रूयतामत्र कारणम् ।। ५-२७-२६ ।।
items.tr:
iyaṃ māyāvatī bhāryyā tanayasyāsya te satī |
śambarasya na bhāryyeyaṃ śrūyatāmatra kāraṇam || 5-27-26 ||

items.text:
मन्मथे तु गते नाशं तदुद्भवपरायाणा ।
शम्बरं मोहयामास मायारूपेण रूपिणी ।। ५-२७-२७ ।।
items.tr:
manmathe tu gate nāśaṃ tadudbhavaparāyāṇā |
śambaraṃ mohayāmāsa māyārūpeṇa rūpiṇī || 5-27-27 ||

items.text:
व्यवायाद्यु पभोगेषु रूपं मायामयं शुभम् ।
दर्शयामास दैत्यस्य तस्येयं मदिरेक्षणा ।। ५-२७-२८ ।।
items.tr:
vyavāyādyu pabhogeṣu rūpaṃ māyāmayaṃ śubham |
darśayāmāsa daityasya tasyeyaṃ madirekṣaṇā || 5-27-28 ||

items.text:
कामोऽवतीर्णः पुत्रस्ते तस्येयं दयिता रतिः ।
विशङ्का नात्र कर्त्तव्या स्नुषेयं तव शोभना ।। ५-२७-२९ ।।
items.tr:
kāmo'vatīrṇaḥ putraste tasyeyaṃ dayitā ratiḥ |
viśaṅkā nātra karttavyā snuṣeyaṃ tava śobhanā || 5-27-29 ||

items.text:
ततो हर्षसमाविष्टा रुक्मिणी केशवस्तथा ।
नगरी च समस्ता सा साधु साध्वित्यभाषत ।। ५-२७-३० ।।
items.tr:
tato harṣasamāviṣṭā rukmiṇī keśavastathā |
nagarī ca samastā sā sādhu sādhvityabhāṣata || 5-27-30 ||

items.text:
चिरं नष्टेन पुत्रेण संयुक्तां प्रेक्ष्य रुक्मिणीम् ।
अवाप विस्मयं सर्व्वो द्रारवत्यां जनस्तदा ।। ५-२७-३१ ।।
items.tr:
ciraṃ naṣṭena putreṇa saṃyuktāṃ prekṣya rukmiṇīm |
avāpa vismayaṃ sarvvo drāravatyāṃ janastadā || 5-27-31 ||

en_chapter: Maitreya saidr—How, Muni, happened it that the hero Pradyumna was carried away by Sambara? And in what manner was the mighty Sambara killed by Pradyumna?

Parāçara said:—When Pradyumna was but six days old, he was stolen from the lying-in chamber by Sambara, terrible as death; for the demon foreknew that Pradyumna, if he lived, would be his destroyer. Taking away the boy, Sambara cast him into the ocean, swarming with monsters, into whirlpool of roaring waves, the haunt of the huge creatures of the deep. A large fish swallowed the child, but he died not, and was born anew from its belly: for that fish, and others, was caught by the fishermen, and delivered by them to the great Asura Sambara. His wife Māyādevi, the mistress of the household, lorded over the cooks. And she espied, when the fish was cut open, a beautiful child looking like a new shoot of tree of love. When struck with curiosity she was asking "Who is this child? How has it come into the belly of the fish?" Nārada came and said to her:—"This is the son of Krishna who creates and destroys the universe. He was stolen away from the nursery room by Samvara. He was devoured by the fish when thrown into the ocean; now he has come under thy control; do thou, O beautiful damsel, tenderly rear this jewel of mankind".

Parāçara said:—Thus addressed by Nārada, she took charge of the child and brought it up from boyhood being attracted by the beauty of his person. O great saint, when the boy attained to youth, Māyāvati, moving like a she-elephant, began to cherish desire for him. And fixing her mind and eyes upon the high-minded Pradyumna, Māyāvati, blinded with lust, gave unto him all her magic powers, Beholding that lotus-eyed damsel thus passionately attached unto him, Krishna's son said to her:—"Why dost thou indulge in feelings which do not become a mother?" She said to him:—"Thou art not my son; thou art the son of the illustrious Vishnu; Kāla Samvara stole thee and threw thee into the ocean; thou wast swallowed by a fish but rescued by me from its belly cut open. O lord thy loving mother is still weeping for thee".

Parāçara said;—Hearing those words Pradyumna invited Samvara for battle. And worked up with ire that highly powerful one fought with him. In the battle the son of Mādhava killed the entire host of Samvara. Having seven times baffled the delusions and mastered them in the eighth he destroyed that demon Samvara. And having got into the welkin with her he proceeded to his father's house. And beholding him descend into the inner apartment with Māyāvati, Krishna's wives considered him as Krishna himself. The highly beautiful Rukmini with her eyes full of tears lovingly said:—"Blessed is the woman who has got such a son in the bloom of youth. Had he been alive my own son Pradyumna would have been his age. Who is the fortunate mother adorned by thee? From the affection I feel for thee and from thy appearance I think thou art assuredly the son of Hari".

Parāçara said:—At this time Krishna arrived there with Nārada; and the latter delightedly said to Rukmini. "This is thy own son who has come here after slaying Sambara, by whom he was carried away when a child from the lying-in chamber. This is the pious Māyāvati, his spouse and not the wife of Samvara. Hear the reason; when Manmatha had perished, the goddess of beauty, being desirous of effecting his revival, fascinated Samvara by the charms of her delusive form. And she, having eyes rolling with inebriation, exhibited herself to him in various illusory enjoyments. This thy son is the incarnation of Kama and this his spouse is the goddess Rati. Do not doubt the least that she is your daughter-in-law".

Thereupon Rukmini and Keshava were worked up with delight and the whole city resounded with the exclamations of praise. And beholding Rukmini regain a son who bad been long lost all the people of Dwārakā were surprised.
